title: GIF Size Limits: Discord, GitHub, WhatsApp and Email
description: Maximum GIF sizes and lengths for Discord (20 MB free), GitHub (10 MB), WhatsApp (6 s video to GIF), Discord emoji and email, plus how to fit a GIF under each.
h1: GIF size limits for Discord, GitHub, WhatsApp and email
card_summary: Upload limits in one table, with the settings that fit a GIF under each.
quick_answer: Discord: 20 MB per file on a free account, 50 MB with Nitro Basic, 500 MB with Nitro; custom emoji 256 KB. GitHub: 10 MB for images and GIFs. WhatsApp: its video-to-GIF switch works on clips of 6 seconds or less. Email: most providers cap attachments around 25 MB. To fit a limit, trim seconds first, then crop, then lower the frame rate.
intro: Every platform that plays GIFs puts a ceiling on them, and the error you get when you go over is rarely helpful.
This page collects the limits that matter most for GIFs made on a phone. Limits change, so each row says where it comes from and when it was checked.

screenshot.caption: Check the estimated size against the limit before you export.

sections.heading: The limits
sections.note: Platforms that convert GIFs to video (Telegram and others) may accept larger files but change how they play. Check the platform's help pages if you are close to a limit.

sections.heading: How to fit under a limit
paragraphs: Cut in this order, because it costs the least quality: seconds first, then crop, then frame rate, then the encoder. Halving the frame rate roughly halves the size; a square crop of a widescreen clip removes almost half of each frame.

sections.heading: Rules of thumb for size
paragraphs: A 3-second reaction at 12 FPS with a cropped frame usually lands in the low single-digit megabytes. A 10-second full-frame clip at 24 FPS can run into tens of megabytes. That is why the estimate before export matters more than any fixed recipe.

steps.heading: Fit a GIF under a limit in Make Video to GIF
steps.intro: Uses the estimated size as your target.

items.name: Note the target
items.text: For example 20 MB for Discord or 10 MB for GitHub.

items.name: Trim
items.text: Keep only the seconds that matter.

items.name: Crop
items.text: Pick an aspect preset around the subject.

items.name: Lower FPS if needed
items.text: Step the frame rate down until the estimate is under the target.

items.name: Convert and upload
items.text: Tap Convert to GIF and upload or share the file.

tips.heading: Tips
items: Leave some margin under a hard limit; estimates are estimates.
For emoji-size limits, start from a tiny square crop and 1–2 seconds.
Bookmark this page; limits change and we update the table.

faq.question: What is the maximum GIF size on Discord?
faq.answer: 20 MB per file on a free account, 50 MB with Nitro Basic and 500 MB with Nitro.

faq.question: How big can a GIF be on GitHub?
faq.answer: 10 MB for images and GIFs attached to issues, pull requests and comments.

faq.question: How long can a GIF be on WhatsApp?
faq.answer: The built-in video-to-GIF switch works on clips of 6 seconds or less.
